description: 13-orbital Slater-Koster tight-binding model for cubic (alpha-phase, Pm-3m) halide perovskites CsBX3. Basis = {B-s, B-px, B-py, B-pz, and X-{px,py,pz} for the three halides X1(on x), X2(on y), X3(on z)}. Spin-orbit coupling lambda*L.S acts on the B-p manifold. B-X coupling is nearest neighbour (distance a/2); B-B coupling is second neighbour (distance a, simple-cubic B sublattice); X-X coupling is neglected (X-p block is diagonal on-site).

source.authors: R. Kashikar, M. Gupta, B. R. K. Nanda
source.title: A Generic Slater-Koster Description of the Electronic Structure of Centrosymmetric Halide Perovskites
source.affiliation: Condensed Matter Theory and Computational Lab, IIT Madras
source.hamiltonian_equations: Eqs. (1)-(8); analytic R-point eigenvalues in Eq. (9)

parameter_keys.E_X_p: On-site energy of X-p orbitals (eps_p2); same for all three halides
parameter_keys.lambda_SOC: Spin-orbit coupling strength lambda on B-p orbitals

lattice_constant_note: Cubic lattice constant 'a' (angstrom). Band energies at/along high-symmetry directions (in units of pi/a) are independent of the numeric value of 'a'; it is recorded for provenance and for plotting k in absolute units. Values are the DFT-optimized cubic lattice constants from Table I of the same paper (experimental value in 'a_expt').

CsGeI3.anomaly: t_BX_sp printed as +1.00 in Table II, whereas every other compound has a negative value (~ -0.94 to -1.29). Transcribed as-printed; treat sign as possibly a typo in the source.

CsPbI3.anomaly: t_BB_ss (+0.01) and t_BB_spsigma (+0.12) printed without the negative sign that the other two Pb compounds carry (Cl: -0.03,-0.13; Br: -0.02,-0.12). Transcribed as-printed; signs of these two small B-B terms may be typos in the source.
